pages.title: Treasure Finder
pages.text: Right-click the dowser to search the area around you for chests that still contain undiscovered loot. Detected chests are highlighted for a short time, making it much easier to find forgotten treasure.

The search reaches up to 4 chunks in every direction and can find chests whose loot has not yet been generated or opened. The dowser has 64 uses and a short cooldown between searches.$(br2)The Left Half and Right Half are only crafting fragments; neither has a use by itself.
